title: SandboxProbe
description: What the fixed sandbox probe saw in one run (docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md P9), the answer to POST /v1/dev/sandbox-probe (operator only). An empty violations list is a pass: no network, an empty HOME, no controller path, no mount from the host but the run's own, no capability, no_new_privs and seccomp, the limits in force, and no socket but the gateway's, which a build run must have.

routes.description: Routing-table entries on interfaces other than lo.

forbidden_present.description: Controller paths (and the controller's home) seen inside.

root.description: The path within its filesystem: / unless a bind.

status.description: Capability sets, NoNewPrivs and Seccomp, from /proc/self/status.

limits.description: The cgroup's memory, pids and cpu limits in force.
